overview_description.description:
Burrow specializes in selling various luxury furniture online. Its furniture is handcrafted from sturdy, sustainably-sourced hardwood and scratch- and stain-resistant, non-toxic fabrics. Burrow is dedicated to reinventing the way people furnish their homes.

The company was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in New York.

product.name: Modular Seating
product.description: Furniture systems composed of multiple pieces that can be arranged in various configurations to suit different spaces and needs.

product.name: Sleeper Sofas
product.description: Sofas that convert into beds, featuring real queen-sized mattresses for both sitting and sleeping comfort.

product.name: Outdoor Furniture Collections (Dunes and Relay)
product.description: Outdoor seating, dining, and lounging furniture made from materials like sustainable teak and galvanized steel, designed for weather resistance.

product.name: Dining Furniture
product.description: Dining tables and chairs designed for everyday use, including extendable tables and various chair styles.

product.name: Shelving and Storage Solutions
product.description: Shelving units and storage furniture designed to organize household items while maintaining functional design.

product.name: Mattresses (Lyric Hybrid Mattress)
product.description: Mattresses combining foam and pocketed coils with cooling features, designed for various sleeping preferences.
